# Inertia show page

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

A show method passes one record's ViewModel to resources/js/pages/<Area>/Show/Page.vue; dates render relative to the viewer's timezone, never by hand. Scaffold it with the Bakery's detail-page recipe (pure Tailwind, --frontend=inertia-vue or inertia-react), which lays out the record at a focused width with its heading, status and actions, then its sections.

Scaffold: `php artisan standards:make crud --flavor=resource <Name>`. With the Bakery (butter/bakery) installed, prefer `php artisan mod:butter/detail-page <Name>`.

Kit: @kit/ui Page, @kit/ui Section, @kit/ui DescriptionList, @kit/ui ButtonGroup, @kit/ui InertiaAction, @kit/ui DropdownAction.
- `Page` from `@kit/ui` for the page shell: Wraps the record page; its #actions slot holds the record's actions (ui-page.header-actions), with no SectionHeader repeating the title (props: title, #actions).
- `Section` from `@kit/ui` for the details: Groups the record fields (props: title).
- `DescriptionList` from `@kit/ui` for the fields: The record's fields as term and description pairs (a real dl), with copy for an id or key (props: items, layout, copyable).
- `ButtonGroup` from `@kit/ui` for the actions: The record's actions written out by name: buttons in the default slot, the rest in the #menu (chevron) (props: default slot, #menu).
- `InertiaAction` from `@kit/ui` for the action button: One named server action as a button; confirms when the action has a confirmationMessage (props: action (null renders nothing)).
- `DropdownAction` from `@kit/ui` for the menu action: One named server action as a menu item (props: action).
Checks: 20, 21, descriptors, js-imports, vm.typed-pages, vm.shaped-arrays, vm.nested-reach, vue.bare-handler-argument, inertia.pure, vm.page-size, ui.page-purpose, ui.page-view-model. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Conventions:
- Every rendered page extends PageViewModel; widgets and partials use ViewModel; `$standalone = true` opts a deliberate exception out (rule ui.page-view-model).

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "What does the page mainly do?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=ui-page.show` to see its siblings.
